items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: So I had a French man there, and he taught me the flute.

ctx.x: Yeah, I took up every instrument. They had enough but they didn't have no flute player, no piccolo player. So I had a French man there, and he taught me the flute.
Wow, I didn't know Tom Whaley was a flute player.
